def comps(cells, conn=4):
    cells=set(cells); seen=set(); out=[]
    from collections import deque
    for c in cells:
        if c in seen: continue
        q=deque([c]); seen.add(c); comp=[c]
        while q:
            r,cc=q.popleft()
            nbrs=[(r+1,cc),(r-1,cc),(r,cc+1),(r,cc-1)]
            if conn==8: nbrs+= [(r+1,cc+1),(r+1,cc-1),(r-1,cc+1),(r-1,cc-1)]
            for n in nbrs:
                if n in cells and n not in seen:
                    seen.add(n); q.append(n); comp.append(n)

    return out
